code_analysis_samples.code: proc hello() { writeln("Hello"); }
proc add(a: int, b: int): int { return a + b; }
proc loop() { for i in 1..100 { writeln(i); } }
proc nested() { for i in 1..10 { for j in 1..10 { if i==j then writeln(i); } } }
proc complex() { for i in 1..10 { if i>5 then { for j in 1..5 { if j==i then writeln(j); } } } }
proc parallel() { forall i in 1..1000 { var x = i * 2; } }
proc array() { var A: [1..100] int; for i in 1..100 { A[i] = i; } }
proc sorting(arr: [?D] int) { for i in D { for j in D { if arr[i] > arr[j] then swap(arr, i, j); } } }
proc matrix(A: [?D1] [?D2] real, B: [?D3] [?D4] real) { var C: [D1, D4] real; forall (i,k) in D1 X D4 { C[i,k] = + reduce (A[i, ] * B[, k]); } }
proc recursive(n: int): int { if n <= 1 then return 1; else return n * recursive(n-1); }
proc distributed(X: [?D]) { forall loc in Locales { on loc { forall i in D { writeln(X[i]); } } } }
proc mapreduce() { var results = map(reduce, data); }
proc deadcode() { var unused = 5; writeln("done"); }
proc duplicate1() { for i in 1..10 { writeln(i * 2); } } proc duplicate2() { for i in 1..10 { writeln(i * 2); } }
proc performance() { var sum = 0; for i in 1..1000000 { sum += i; } }
proc safety() { var ptr: c_ptr(int) = c_nil; ptr[0] = 5; }
proc exception() { try { var x = a / b; } catch { writeln("Error"); } }
proc streaming(data: [] int) { for x in data { process(x); } }
proc race() { var count = 0; forall i in 1..1000 { count += 1; } }
proc generic(T: type) { var x: T; return x; }
